retrievalProfile.description: A centered vertical layout featuring a framed group portrait below stacked, multi-colored geometric typography on a solid black background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A classic 1960s soul album aesthetic characterized by a central framed photograph of a vocal group, topped by bold, lowercase geometric sans-serif typography with specific color-coding for emphasis, all set against a deep black field.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of text elements above a central image
Contrast between vibrant magenta accents and stark white text
Thin white border framing the central photographic subject
Symmetrical balance anchored by the central group pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of three figures occupies the lower two-thirds of the composition, contained within a white-bordered frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large magenta word in the center of the text block acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top 'Stereo' indicator, moves down through the artist name and title, and rests on the framed portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central elements, creating a high-contrast, spotlight effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with saturated magenta against a dark, low-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with circular counters and uniform stroke weight.
letterConstructionRules: Strictly lowercase for primary display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform typeface family using color and scale to differentiate hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Horizontal 'Stereo' banner with arrows at the top

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric lowercase aesthetic and tight tracking of the era.
Provides the necessary geometric circularity for the 'o' and 'e'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background with a centered, white-bordered rectangular frame containing a 1960s-style studio portrait of three men in brown suits and tan trousers against a blue backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered lowercase geometric sans-serif text above the frame. The top line should be white, the middle line should feature a large magenta word flanked by smaller magenta words, and the bottom lines should be smaller white and magenta text.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text strictly lowercase?
Is the central image enclosed in a thin white border?
Is the color magenta used for emphasis in the title?

mustRedesign: Uppercase letters in the main title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'Stereo' banner is present at the top edge.
Ensure the magenta text is clearly legible against the black.
Verify the group portrait is centered within its frame.
Confirm all display text is lowercase.
recipe.reuseFormula: Black background + centered framed portrait + stacked lowercase geometric sans-serif typography (White/Magenta mix).
